description: Lists installed packages as structured dependency data. Auto-detects package manager via lock files (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

all.description: Show complete dependency tree (maps to --all for npm)

args.description: Escape-hatch for PM-specific flags not modeled in the schema

filter.description: pnpm workspace filter pattern (e.g., '@scope/pkg', './packages/foo'). Only used with pnpm.

long.description: Show extended info such as description and homepage (maps to --long)

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

packages.description: Specific package names to check if installed and at what version

production.description: Show only production dependencies (maps to --omit=dev for npm, --prod for pnpm)

workspace.description: Workspace to list packages for (maps to --workspace for npm)

name: list

type.description: Dependency type: production, dev, or optional

dependencyCount.description: Total number of dependencies including nested ones (set in compact output)

omittedDependencyCount.description: Number of top-level dependencies omitted from compact output (use compact: false for the full tree)

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

problems.description: Problems reported by npm ls (e.g., missing/extraneous/invalid deps)

title: List Packages
